name: benchmark-medMCQA_tb-IFT
description: A multiple-choice medical question-answering dataset derived from the medMCQA family, designed to evaluate models on clinical and medical exam style questions. It measures the ability of models to select the correct option among distractors across medical topics and is used for benchmarking medical QA and fine-tuning experiments.
reputation: Part of the medMCQA family; commonly used in medical QA research and benchmarking, with moderate adoption in the clinical-NLP community.
